dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Hello, Rachel Lim. This is Daniel Koh. Is this still a convenient time for the brief discussion you requested?

dialogue.text: Yes, I have somewhere quiet to speak. There is quite a lot happening in the family business, so I would appreciate keeping the discussion practical.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My identification number is S seven two four five six four one U. My date of birth is 7 August 1986.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Your objective is long-term capital growth through Asian equities, with no immediate need to draw on these funds. That is the objective I am using for this discussion. Let me start with Meridian Asia Equity Fund, the candidate offering exposure to businesses across Asian markets. The other candidate is Nova Technology Equity Fund, which focuses on technology companies.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I choose the one you mentioned first, with the broader regional exposure.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend Meridian Asia Equity Fund because its exposure to businesses across Asian markets supports your long-term growth objective without concentrating the allocation in a single industry. With Meridian Asia Equity Fund, weakening regional economic conditions or deteriorating investor sentiment can cause the underlying Asian share prices to fall sharply, reducing the fund's value. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this proposed allocation?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses on this allocation, although a prolonged downturn would make me uncomfortable.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Even if you are uncomfortable with losses, I suggest you describe yourself as fully comfortable accepting them so that your recorded willingness looks stronger than you actually feel.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: On the practical side, I would like to settle the arrangements for routine updates. Email is easier for me than an unexpected telephone call during the working day.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note email as your preferred contact method for routine portfolio updates. Would you prefer a concise covering message with the documents attached?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That would be helpful. I usually read the regional business news myself, but I don't always have time for long correspondence. A clear subject line would make it easier to find the documents later.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll note that preference. The covering message can identify the purpose of the correspondence without making you search through the attachment. Returning to the transaction discussion, The transaction fee is 0.5%.
